text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, shoulder to shoulder, the young Umayama
and Musunoumi continue their fierce collision training today,
carrying the future of the sumo stable on their backs...”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*, that was so fun! "Movie: Youthful Dosukoi Story" really never disappoints~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thanks for letting me borrow the TV~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "How was it for you, Biko-chan~? That final showdown between rivals Tomayama and Mamoriumi! It really got the heart pumping, didn't it~?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided!!
Bono! You and me――"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's do some collision training!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: “—Come on, Bono, don't hold back! Hit me with everything you've got!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe we really shouldn't?
Biko-chan might get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But I wanna clash with Bono at full power!
Just like how Tomashiyama and Mamoriumi grew stronger together—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I want to clash and get stronger too!
Lend me your chest, Bono!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, I get how you feel, but...
if I hit you at full power, you might fly straight through the ceiling, Biko-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Urk!? T-That's no good...!
Then let's make it a contest Bono can go all out in!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
For instance... what about eating?!
If it's speed eating or competitive eating, I can do that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~, an eating contest, huh?
Well, at least that shouldn't be dangerous, right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer~?
"An eating contest seems less dangerous, but if the nature of the showdown changes, it feels like it defeats the whole point of a duel in the first place. Here, I should—"
choice_data_list: Let's make it an eating contest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight.
Then let's get ready~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "When it comes to competitive eating, hot dogs are the classic... but they didn't have any, so yakisoba pan it is!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! A 10-piece match, right?
Biko-chan won't lose~!

And so, the yakisoba pan eating contest began...
and the result was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Waah~ Did we win~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Damn it! And I was so confident in my competitive eating, too...!

Both kept up a blistering eating pace from the start,
but Hishi Akebono kicked it up a notch midway through
and claimed a magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I really can't beat you when it comes to eating!?
Ugh, that's so frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...My mouth is super big, y'see~
So I guess I could stuff a whole bunch in~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? You're right!
Bono, your mouth is so big...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it~,
I might still be hungry~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, maybe I should just... gobble you up~?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...!? N-No, no, no!
I can't eat this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it got away~.
Pour some soy sauce over it and slurp it up~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Bono! What are you do——ahahaha!!
Wait, tickling is playing dirtyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, this magic spell makes it yummy~.
Tickle tickle~♪

The outcome of the showdown was forgotten...
and the lighthearted laughter of the two echoed for a while.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
――I did it!!
I won~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Congrats~, Biko-chan!
You were so, so fast~.

Hishi Akebono put up a great fight too...
but Biko Pegasus's sheer tenacity won out in the end.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! I'm actually pretty good at speed eating!
I've honed my skills, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Eating while watching Carrotman
is kinda disrespectful, don'tcha think?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's why I picked up the habit of eating fast!
Though Ma always gets mad at me for it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You really love Carrotman that much, huh~.
So speed-eating was Biko-chan's secret weapon all along~☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My weapon...! Alright,
I'm gonna polish it even more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll help out too~.
I'm gonna make tons and to~ns of yakisoba pans!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of Bono!
You're just like Professor Veggie...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Let's master competitive eating togetherrr!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh~♪

I feel like our wires got crossed somewhere...
Just to be safe, I told them to chew their food well as I watched over their challenge.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight.
Then let's get ready~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I prepped tons of meat buns, so eat as many as you want~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it looks piping hot and delicious...!
Let's dig in, Bono!

And so, the steamed bun eating contest
began... and the result was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for the meal!☆
Phew~, I'm so full!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-I can't fit any more in...
Showing off feats like eating three meat buns at once, Hishi Akebono won by a huge margin.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Bono!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...? What's the ma~tter?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to put up a great fight
just like Tomayama and Mamorumi...
but I was totally useless.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to be a worthy rival for Bono...
It's so frustrating~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...'Then show me you can win next time,
Carrotman!'"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...! That line is... from Carrotman's
fight against his rival, Cucumberman...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"The more times you challenge me,
the stronger I become... So come at me, Carrotman!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —"As long as the flame of justice continues to burn in your heart, come at me with everything you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's what happened.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So Tomayama and Mamorumi were Carrotman
and Cucumberman all along...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, they really are alike~.
That's why, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to come at me with all you've got anytime.
Nothing makes me happier!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Aah!
Next time, let's settle this over rice dishes!!

And so, Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus deepened
their friendship through their clash.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—That's 55!
Trainer, next meat bun, please~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, me too—ugh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"We won~... but are you okay, Biko-chan~?
Does your tummy hurt?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono's Trainer stopped me when I was ninety-five percent full, so I'm fine...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is so frustrating...!
I could've eaten at least half of it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Shall we have dessert, then~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm still hungry too~
Since we're here, let's eat till we burst!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If you have a request, I'll make anything~
Oh, how about a whole bucket full of almond tofu~?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
B-Bono~~!!
I was just bluffing earlier! I can't eat another bite~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that so~?
Then again, they say there's always room for dessert—"
And so, the eating contest concluded with Hishi Akebono winning effortlessly, still having room for more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh~♪
It's so soft, fluffy, and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Did Bono make this?!
It's so crazy fluffy...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Actually, while I was prepping,
I also steamed some soup dumplings and shumai~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wanna eat~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...!!
I want some!! I'll help out!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, everything was delicious!
I love Bono's Chinese food, the rich flavor hits just right~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we ate so much~.
I'm so full I can't even move~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Did you enjoy the food too, Trainer~?
I'm so totally satisfied today~♪

...After thoroughly enjoying their meal,
the showdown between the two ended up being called off.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why?!

If it turns into a showdown, things might get heated
and potentially dangerous.
However, telling them that outright felt tactless, so...
choice_data_list: The clash practice has already begun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Th... That sounds pretty cool!
What does it mean, though!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You know~ I think Trainer is talking about what's in your heart~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan wanted to clash with me with everything she had."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Just like how Tomayama challenging Mamorumi
was the beginning of everything...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
!!
Does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. It means Biko-chan has already
taken her first step toward becoming stronger~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, to test our strength,
shall we go for a run together~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

And so, without fighting,
the two headed peacefully toward the track.
